tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a header/metadata field not represented as a canonical leaf element in the IRS8867 schema.

taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a header field on the form but no corresponding canonical element exists in the IRS8867 schema candidate list.

taxpayer_tin.rationale: Taxpayer SSN/ITIN is a header field on the form but no corresponding canonical element exists in the IRS8867 schema candidate list.

preparer_name.rationale: PreparerPersonNm directly corresponds to the paid preparer's name field on the form.

preparer_tin.rationale: PTIN directly corresponds to the Preparer Tax Identification Number field on the form.

employer_name.rationale: Preparer's employer/firm name is not represented as a canonical leaf element in the IRS8867 schema candidate list.

employer_ein.rationale: Employer EIN is not represented as a canonical leaf element in the IRS8867 schema candidate list.

preparer_signature_date.rationale: Preparer signature date is not represented as a canonical leaf element in the IRS8867 schema candidate list.

eic_claimed.rationale: EICClaimedInd directly corresponds to the Part I checkbox for whether the Earned Income Credit is claimed.

ctc_actc_odc_claimed.rationale: CTCACTCODCClaimedInd directly corresponds to the Part I checkbox for whether CTC/ACTC/ODC is claimed.

aotc_claimed.rationale: AOTCClaimedInd directly corresponds to the Part I checkbox for whether the American Opportunity Tax Credit is claimed.

hoh_claimed.rationale: HOHClaimedInd directly corresponds to the Part I checkbox for whether Head of Household filing status is claimed.

q1_interview_conducted.rationale: TxpyrProvidedOrObtainedInfoInd corresponds to Part I, Question 1 regarding whether the preparer obtained required information from the taxpayer through interview.

q2_information_consistent.rationale: IncorIncmplInconInfoInd corresponds to Part I, Question 2 regarding whether the taxpayer's information appeared consistent with prior information.

q3_records_kept.rationale: WorkPaperDocumentNm is the closest candidate relating to records kept, though it is a name field rather than a boolean indicator; no boolean indicator for record-keeping at the Part I level exists in the candidate list.

eic_q1_taxpayer_eligible.rationale: EICEligibleClaimQlfyChildInd corresponds to Part II, Question 1 regarding whether the taxpayer is eligible to claim EIC including qualifying child determination.

eic_q2_qualifying_child_records.rationale: ExplainLiveWithChldRqrClaimInd relates to explaining requirements for a child qualifying for EIC, which aligns with Part II, Question 2 on qualifying child records.

eic_q3_tiebreaker_considered.rationale: ExplainTiebreakerRulesCd corresponds to Part II, Question 3 regarding whether the preparer considered tiebreaker rules for qualifying children.

eic_q4_self_employment_income.rationale: QstnToCompleteCorrectSchCCd is the closest candidate relating to self-employment schedule completion for EIC, aligning with Part II, Question 4 on net self-employment income.

eic_q5_knowledge_standard.rationale: DocumentInquiryInd relates to the knowledge standard inquiry about incorrect or inconsistent information, aligning with Part II, Question 5.

eic_q6_records_retained.rationale: SatisfyRecordRetentionRqrInd corresponds to whether the preparer retained required due diligence documentation, aligning with Part II, Question 6 on EIC records retained.

ctc_q1_qualifying_child_determined.rationale: No candidate element specifically maps to Part III, Question 1 for CTC qualifying child determination; the schema does not expose a dedicated boolean for this question.

ctc_q2_odc_dependent_determined.rationale: No candidate element specifically maps to Part III, Question 2 for ODC dependent determination; the schema does not expose a dedicated boolean for this question.

ctc_q3_knowledge_standard.rationale: MakeInquiryInd relates to making inquiries about incorrect or inconsistent information, which aligns with the knowledge standard question in Part III, Question 3.

ctc_q4_records_retained.rationale: SatisfyKnowledgeRequirementInd is the closest candidate relating to satisfying due diligence requirements for CTC/ACTC/ODC records retained in Part III, Question 4.

aotc_q1_student_eligible.rationale: CrEligibilityCertificationInd relates to certifying credit eligibility, which aligns with Part IV, Question 1 on AOTC student eligibility determination.

aotc_q2_1098t_reviewed.rationale: SubstantiateCrEligibilityInd relates to substantiating credit eligibility through documents reviewed, aligning with Part IV, Question 2 on Form 1098-T review.

aotc_q3_eligible_institution.rationale: USCitizenOrNationalInd is not a strong match; however, no candidate specifically addresses eligible educational institution determination for AOTC Part IV, Question 3, so this is null.

aotc_q4_qualified_expenses.rationale: SubstProvQlfyTuitionExpnssInd directly corresponds to substantiating qualified tuition expenses, aligning with Part IV, Question 4 on qualified education expenses.

aotc_q5_knowledge_standard.rationale: No remaining candidate element specifically maps to Part IV, Question 5 for the AOTC knowledge standard about incorrect or inconsistent information.

aotc_q6_records_retained.rationale: No remaining candidate element specifically maps to Part IV, Question 6 for AOTC records retained.

aotc_institution_name.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to the name of the eligible educational institution; the schema does not expose a dedicated institution name field.

hoh_q1_eligible_determined.rationale: HOHFilingStatusInd corresponds to Part V, Question 1 regarding whether the taxpayer is eligible for HOH filing status determination.

hoh_q2_qualifying_person_determined.rationale: EligibleClaimHOHInd corresponds to Part V, Question 2 regarding whether a qualifying person supports the HOH filing status.

hoh_q3_knowledge_standard.rationale: No remaining candidate element specifically maps to Part V, Question 3 for the HOH knowledge standard about incorrect or inconsistent information.

hoh_q4_records_retained.rationale: No remaining candidate element specifically maps to Part V, Question 4 for HOH records retained.
